messages:
Mei Huang: Hey team — draft for the product launch post is ready: https://docs.google.com/example (please don't edit the headline yet). Need quick sign-offs on: legal claims, benchmark phrasing, webinar CTA + registration flow, and demo scheduling. Can folks scan and react with ✋ if you can review today?

Alex Rivera: Reading now. Quick note — the benchmark line says "3x cheaper" which feels strong. Can we say "up to 3x lower per-token cost in our internal benchmark for long-form generation"? also we should call out test workload (LLM-serve synthetic).

Sara Patel: Mei — I can do legal later today. Agree with Alex, avoid absolute language unless we have a public benchmark link. Also flagging the customer quote on para 4 — need approval from customer comms or anonymize.

Jamal Patel: For the CTA, we'd prefer the registration link to include hidden UTM + a HubSpot flow param so leads route to Solutions queue. Example: /register?utm_campaign=redwood_launch&utm_source=blog&hubspot_flow=solutions-demo. Can marketing ops add that?

Olivia Chen: Webinar ops — we have two demo engineers available July 11 & 12. Which do you want? Also preference to run a dry-run on July 10 with full slide deck + demo env. I can block rooms if we pick a time.

marketing-bot: Reminder: Brand QA and image assets must be in the final folder 24h before publish. See https://assets.redwood.internal/brand-checklist (auto-reminder). :bell:

Mei Huang: Thanks — pulled edits into v2 (link updated above). Quick publish runbook (copying here):
```
- Final doc link: https://docs.google.com/example
- Legal sign-off: @Sara Patel
- Bench claims & data source: @Alex Rivera
- Customer quote: confirm with comms -> if no reply, anonymize
- CTA + UTM: @Jamal Patel to provide final link
- Webinar: pick date + dry-run -> @Olivia Chen
- Assets (images/hero): marketing ops to upload to /brand-assets
- Publish time: target 9:00 AM PDT, coordinate distro 10 mins after
```
Can we try to close all items by EOD so we can schedule brand QA 24h out?

Alex Rivera: Nice checklist. Small headline tweak suggestion: "Ship inference that scales — predictable latency, lower unit cost" (shorter). +1 to anonymize the customer quote if comms doesn't respond.

Sara Patel: Signed off on the revised claim language: "up to 3x lower per-token cost in our internal benchmarks for long-form workloads". I also approved anonymized quote option.

Olivia Chen: Booked dry-run: July 10, 11:00 AM PST. Demo room + recording reserved for July 11 demo slot. Will post calendar invites.

Mei Huang: Awesome — closing this thread. I'll post final publish checklist once brand ops confirms assets. Thanks all! :tada:
